title: Giving Your Name at Reception
somali_title: Magacaaga oo aad ka sheegto soo-dhoweynta
situation: A resident gives their full name at a reception desk and spells the surname so the record is correct.
somali_situation: Qof deggan ayaa soo-dhoweynta ka sheegaya magaciisa oo buuxa, kadibna magaca qoyska ayuu higgaadinayaa si diiwaanku sax u noqdo.
key_phrases: What is your full name?
My first name is Ayaan and my surname is Warsame.
Could you spell your surname, please?
Do you use a preferred name?
I have your name as Ayaan Warsame.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Good morning. What is your full name?
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan. Magacaaga oo buuxa waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: My first name is Ayaan and my surname is Warsame.
dialogue.somali: Magacayga hore waa Ayaan, magaca qoyskayguna waa Warsame.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Could you spell your surname, please?
dialogue.somali: Fadlan magaca qoyskaaga ma ii higgaadin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: W-A-R-S-A-M-E.
dialogue.somali: W-A-R-S-A-M-E.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Thank you. Do you use a preferred name?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Ma leedahay magac aad doorbido in laguugu yeero?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, please call me Ayaan.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan Ayaan iigu yeer.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I have your name as Ayaan Warsame.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan magacaaga u qoray Ayaan Warsame.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, that spelling is correct.
dialogue.somali: Haa, higgaadintaasi waa sax.

title: Registering a Child for a Class
situation: A parent gives their child's age and date of birth while registering for a swimming class.
somali_situation: Waalid ayaa sheegaya da'da ilmahiisa iyo taariikhda dhalashada marka uu u diiwaangelinayo fasal dabaal.
key_phrases: Are you registering an adult or a child?
My daughter is twelve years old.
What is her date of birth?
I am thirty-eight years old.
The adult form is for you, and the child form is for her.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Are you registering an adult or a child?
dialogue.somali: Ma qof weyn ayaad diiwaangelinaysaa mise ilmo?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: A child. My daughter is twelve years old.
dialogue.somali: Ilmo. Gabadheydu waa laba iyo toban jir.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Thank you. What is her date of birth?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Taariikhdeeda dhalasho waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: She was born on May fifth, 2014.
dialogue.somali: Waxay dhalatay shanta May, 2014.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: I also need your age as the parent.
dialogue.somali: Sidoo kale waxaan u baahanahay da'daada waalid ahaan.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: I am thirty-eight years old.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan ahay siddeed iyo soddon jir.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Is your daughter joining the child swim class?
dialogue.somali: Gabadhaadu ma ku biiraysaa fasalka dabaasha ee carruurta?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Yes, the class for her age group.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fasalka kooxdeeda da'da ah.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Perfect. The adult form is for you, and the child form is for her.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Foomka qofka weyn adiga ayaa leh, foomka ilmuhuna iyada ayuu u yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: That makes sense. I will fill in both forms.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa ii caddahay. Labada foom waan buuxin doonaa.

title: Stating Your Nationality on a Form
somali_title: Jinsiyaddaada oo aad foom ku sheegto
situation: An applicant asks how to state nationality, country, citizenship, and residency correctly on a visitor form.
somali_situation: Qof codsanaya adeeg ayaa weydiinaya sida saxda ah ee foom loogu qoro jinsiyadda, dalka, muwaadinimada, iyo deganaanshaha.
key_phrases: I need to check your nationality for the visitor form.
Which country are you from?
Are you a Somali citizen?
I am a resident now.
The form asks for nationality, not ethnic group.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.english: I need to check your nationality for the visitor form.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan hubiyo jinsiyaddaada foomka booqdaha.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: Of course.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.english: Which country are you from?
dialogue.somali: Dalkee ayaad ka timid?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: I am from Somalia.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan ka imid Soomaaliya.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.english: Are you a Somali citizen?
dialogue.somali: Ma tahay muwaadin Soomaaliyeed?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: Yes, I am a Somali citizen.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan ahay muwaadin Soomaaliyeed.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.english: Do you live here as a visitor or a resident?
dialogue.somali: Halkan ma ku nooshahay booqde ahaan mise degane ahaan?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: I am a resident now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waxaan ahay degane.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.english: Thank you. The form asks for nationality, not ethnic group.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Foomku wuxuu weydiinayaa jinsiyadda, ma aha qowmiyadda.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: Then I should write Somali, correct?
dialogue.somali: Markaa waa inaan qoro Soomaali, sax miyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.english: Yes, write Somali and the country as Somalia.
dialogue.somali: Haa, qor Soomaali, dalkana Soomaaliya.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: Great. That is clear.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Taasi way caddahay.

title: Giving an Address for Delivery
situation: A customer gives a delivery address and adds apartment and entrance details so a parcel reaches the right place.
somali_situation: Macaamiil ayaa bixinaya cinwaan keenis, kadibna wuxuu ku darayaa faahfaahinta guriga iyo albaabka si xirmadu meesha saxda ah u gaarto.
key_phrases: I need the full address.
The house number is 18.
It is on Maple Street, near the pharmacy.
The postcode is 55408.
The entrance is on the side street.

dialogue.speaker: Delivery Clerk
dialogue.english: I can send the parcel today, but I need the full address.
dialogue.somali: Xirmada maanta waan diri karaa, laakiin waxaan u baahanahay cinwaanka oo buuxa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Sure. The house number is 18.
dialogue.somali: Hubaal. Lambarka gurigu waa 18.

dialogue.speaker: Delivery Clerk
dialogue.english: What street is it on?
dialogue.somali: Wadaddee ayuu ku yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It is on Maple Street, near the pharmacy.
dialogue.somali: Waxay ku taal Maple Street, farmashiyaha agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Delivery Clerk
dialogue.english: Which city should I write?
dialogue.somali: Magaaladee ayaan qoraa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Write Minneapolis as the city.
dialogue.somali: Magaalada ku qor Minneapolis.

dialogue.speaker: Delivery Clerk
dialogue.english: Do you know the postcode?
dialogue.somali: Ma taqaannaa lambarka boostada?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, the postcode is 55408.
dialogue.somali: Haa, lambarka boostadu waa 55408.

dialogue.speaker: Delivery Clerk
dialogue.english: Let me read it back: 18 Maple Street, Minneapolis, 55408.
dialogue.somali: Aan dib u akhriyo: 18 Maple Street, Minneapolis, 55408.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That's right, but please add Apartment 3B.
dialogue.somali: Waa sax, laakiin fadlan ku dar Apartment 3B.

dialogue.speaker: Delivery Clerk
dialogue.english: Is the apartment above the shop or behind it?
dialogue.somali: Gurigu ma dukaanka ayuu ka sarreeyaa mise gadaashiisa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It is above the shop, second floor.
dialogue.somali: Waxay ka sarreysaa dukaanka, dabaqa labaad.

dialogue.speaker: Delivery Clerk
dialogue.english: Should the driver call before delivery?
dialogue.somali: Darawalku ma wacaa ka hor keenista?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, because the entrance is on the side street.
dialogue.somali: Haa, sababtoo ah albaabku wuxuu ku yaal waddada dhinaceeda.

dialogue.speaker: Delivery Clerk
dialogue.english: I have the full address now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waxaan hayaa cinwaanka oo buuxa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thank you. That will help the parcel arrive safely.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Taasi waxay ka caawin doontaa xirmada inay si nabad ah u gaarto.

title: Updating a Phone Number
situation: A resident updates a mobile phone number and gives the country code and digits slowly.
somali_situation: Qof deggan ayaa cusbooneysiinaya lambarka telefoonka gacanta, wuxuuna si tartiib ah u sheegayaa koodhka dalka iyo tirooyinka.
key_phrases: My phone number has changed.
Is it a mobile phone?
Please say the country code first.
Now say each digit slowly.
I saved the new phone number.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: My phone number has changed. I need to update my contact.
dialogue.somali: Lambarkayga telefoonka wuu is beddelay. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan cusbooneysiiyo xiriirkayga.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: No problem. Is it a mobile phone?
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Ma telefoon gacanta ah baa?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, it is my mobile number.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa lambarkayga mobile-ka.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Please say the country code first.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan marka hore sheeg koodhka dalka.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: The country code is plus one.
dialogue.somali: Koodhka dalku waa plus one.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Now say each digit slowly.
dialogue.somali: Hadda tiro kasta si tartiib ah u sheeg.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Thank you. I saved the new phone number.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Waxaan kaydiyey lambarka telefoonka cusub.

title: Giving Family Details at School
somali_title: Faahfaahinta qoyska oo dugsiga laga bixinayo
situation: A parent gives household and family details for a school form.
somali_situation: Waalid ayaa foom dugsi ku bixinaya faahfaahinta guriga iyo qoyska.
key_phrases: I need a little family information for the school form.
How many people are in your household?
Two parents and two children.
Does he have a sibling at this school?
Can we call another relative if a parent is not available?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: I need a little family information for the school form.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay macluumaad yar oo qoyska ah foomka dugsiga.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Of course. What do you need?
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Maxaad u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: How many people are in your household?
dialogue.somali: Immisa qof ayaa gurigiinna ku nool?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Four. Two parents and two children.
dialogue.somali: Afar. Laba waalid iyo laba carruur ah.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Is the child in this class your son?
dialogue.somali: Ilmaha fasalkan ku jira ma wiilkaaga baa?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Yes, he is my son.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa wiilkayga.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Does he have a sibling at this school?
dialogue.somali: Ma leeyahay walaal dugsigan dhigta?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Yes, his sister is in grade three.
dialogue.somali: Haa, walaashiis waxay dhigataa fasalka saddexaad.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Can we call another relative if a parent is not available?
dialogue.somali: Ma wici karnaa qaraabo kale haddii waalid la heli waayo?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Yes, his uncle is the relative to call.
dialogue.somali: Haa, adeerkiis ayaa ah qaraabada la wacayo.

title: Answering a Marital Status Question
somali_title: Su'aal xaaladda guurka ah oo laga jawaabayo
situation: A clinic clerk asks a resident for marital status while completing an intake form.
somali_situation: Karraani rug caafimaad ayaa qof deggan weydiinaya xaaladda guurka marka uu buuxinayo foomka qaabilaadda.
key_phrases: This form asks for your marital status.
Are you single, married, divorced, or widowed?
My marital status is the same.
I will mark married for you.
Thank you for asking respectfully.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: This form asks for your marital status.
dialogue.somali: Foomkani wuxuu weydiinayaa xaaladdaada guurka.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: All right.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Are you single, married, divorced, or widowed?
dialogue.somali: Ma keli baad tahay, ma guursatay, ma kala tagtay, mise lamaane kaa dhintay?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: I am married.
dialogue.somali: Waan guursaday.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Has your status changed recently?
dialogue.somali: Xaaladdaadu dhowaan ma is beddeshay?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: No, my marital status is the same.
dialogue.somali: Maya, xaaladdayda guurku waa sidii hore.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Thank you. We ask because emergency paperwork uses it.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Waxaan u weydiinnaa sababtoo ah waraaqaha degdegga ah ayaa u baahan.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: I understand.
dialogue.somali: Waan fahmay.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: If someone is divorced or widowed, should they write that?
dialogue.somali: Haddii qof kala tagay ama lamaane ka dhintay yahay, ma inuu sidaas qoro?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, they should choose the word that is true.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa inay doortaan erayga runta ah.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Exactly. I will mark married for you.
dialogue.somali: Sax. Waxaan kuu calaamadeynayaa inaad guursatay.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Thank you for asking respectfully.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad si xushmad leh u weydiisay.

title: Explaining Your Occupation
situation: A resident completes an application with help from an adviser and explains job title, employment status, and main duties.
somali_situation: Qof deggan ayaa la-taliye ka helaya caawimo buuxinta codsi, wuxuuna sharaxayaa cinwaanka shaqada, xaaladda shaqada, iyo hawlaha ugu waaweyn.
key_phrases: The application asks for your occupation.
What job title should I write?
I am employed full-time.
What are your main duties?
I was unemployed for three months.

dialogue.speaker: Adviser
dialogue.english: The application asks for your occupation.
dialogue.somali: Codsigu wuxuu weydiinayaa shaqadaada.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: I work as a bus driver.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u shaqeeyaa darawal bas.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Adviser
dialogue.english: What job title should I write?
dialogue.somali: Cinwaanka shaqada maxaan qoraa?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Please write bus driver.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan qor darawal bas.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Adviser
dialogue.english: Are you employed full-time?
dialogue.somali: Ma shaqeysaa waqti buuxa?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, I am employed full-time.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan shaqeeyaa waqti buuxa.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Adviser
dialogue.english: What are your main duties?
dialogue.somali: Hawlahaaga ugu waaweyn waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: I drive passengers safely and check the bus before each route.
dialogue.somali: Rakaabka si nabad ah ayaan u kaxeeyaa, baskana waan hubiyaa ka hor jid kasta.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Adviser
dialogue.english: Have you ever been unemployed for a long period?
dialogue.somali: Weligaa muddo dheer shaqo la'aan ma ahayd?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, last year I was unemployed for three months.
dialogue.somali: Haa, sannadkii hore saddex bilood ayaan shaqo la'aan ahaa.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Adviser
dialogue.english: Thank you for explaining that clearly.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad taas si cad u sharaxday.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Should I include my current employer?
dialogue.somali: Ma ku daraa shirkadda aan hadda u shaqeeyo?

dialogue.speaker: Adviser
dialogue.english: Yes, write the company name under employer.
dialogue.somali: Haa, magaca shirkadda ku qor meesha loo shaqeeyaha.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: I can do that.
dialogue.somali: Waan samayn karaa taas.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
Adviser
dialogue.english: Your occupation section is complete now.
dialogue.somali: Qaybta shaqadaada hadda way dhammaatay.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Good. I wanted it to be accurate.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Waxaan rabay inay sax noqoto.

title: Giving Your Education Level
situation: A student tells a school clerk their education level, certificate, and current course.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa karraaniga dugsiga u sheegaya heerkiisa waxbarasho, shahaadadiisa, iyo koorsada uu hadda dhigto.
key_phrases: What is your education level?
I finished secondary school.
Is that certificate your highest qualification?
I am taking an English course now.
I will write secondary school as your education.

dialogue.speaker: School Clerk
dialogue.english: What is your education level?
dialogue.somali: Heerkaaga waxbarasho waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I finished secondary school.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan dhammeeyey dugsiga sare.

dialogue.speaker: School Clerk
dialogue.english: Do you have a certificate?
dialogue.somali: Shahaado ma haysataa?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Yes, I have my school certificate.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan haystaa shahaadadayda dugsiga.

dialogue.speaker: School Clerk
dialogue.english: Is that certificate your highest qualification?
dialogue.somali: Shahaadadaasi ma tahay aqoontaada ugu sarreysa?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Yes, and I am taking an English course now.
dialogue.somali: Haa, haddana waxaan dhigtaa koorso Ingiriisi ah.

dialogue.speaker: School Clerk
dialogue.english: I will write secondary school as your education.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan waxbarashadaada u qorayaa dugsi sare.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Thank you. That is correct.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Taasi waa sax.

title: Choosing a Preferred Language
somali_title: Luqadda aad doorbidayso oo la dooranayo
situation: A resident tells a receptionist which language they prefer and what they can speak, read, and write.
somali_situation: Qof deggan ayaa soo-dhoweeye u sheegaya luqadda uu doorbido iyo waxa uu ku hadli karo, akhriyi karo, qori karona.
key_phrases: Which language do you prefer for appointments?
I speak some English, but I am not fluent.
Can you read English letters?
Can you write in English?
I will note Somali as your preferred language.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Which language do you prefer for appointments?
dialogue.somali: Luqaddee ayaad u doorbidaysaa ballamaha?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Somali, please.
dialogue.somali: Soomaali, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Do you speak English too?
dialogue.somali: Ingiriisna ma ku hadashaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I speak some English, but I am not fluent.
dialogue.somali: Wax yar oo Ingiriis ah waan ku hadlaa, laakiin si fiican uguma hadlo.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Can you read English letters?
dialogue.somali: Ma akhriyi kartaa waraaqaha Ingiriisiga?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I can read simple letters.
dialogue.somali: Waan akhriyi karaa waraaqo fudud.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Can you write in English?
dialogue.somali: Ingiriis ma ku qori kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I can write my name and address.
dialogue.somali: Magacayga iyo cinwaankayga waan qori karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: I will note Somali as your preferred language.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan qori doonaa in Soomaaligu yahay luqadda aad doorbidayso.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Thank you. I use both languages, but Somali is easier.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Labada luqadood waan isticmaalaa, laakiin Soomaaligu wuu ii fudud yahay.

title: Adding an Emergency Contact
somali_title: Xiriir degdeg ah oo lagu darayo
situation: A resident gives a receptionist the name, relationship, and phone number of the person to call in an emergency.
somali_situation: Qof deggan ayaa soo-dhoweeye siinaya magaca, xiriirka, iyo lambarka telefoonka qofka la wacayo marka xaalad degdeg ahi timaado.
key_phrases: We need an emergency contact for your file.
Is she a relative who lives nearby?
What is her phone number?
Should we contact her only in an emergency?
I have Hodan Ali as your emergency contact.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: We need an emergency contact for your file.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay xiriir degdeg ah oo faylkaaga lagu daro.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: I can give my sister's details.
dialogue.somali: Faahfaahinta walaashay waan bixin karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Is she a relative who lives nearby?
dialogue.somali: Ma tahay qaraabo meel dhow ku nool?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, she is my relative and she lives ten minutes away.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa qaraabadayda, waxayna degan tahay meel toban daqiiqo u jirta.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: What is her phone number?
dialogue.somali: Lambarkeeda telefoonku waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Her phone number is 612-555-0144.
dialogue.somali: Lambarkeeda telefoonku waa 612-555-0144.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Should we contact her only in an emergency?
dialogue.somali: Ma la xiriirnaa iyada oo keliya marka xaalad degdeg ahi jirto?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, only if it is urgent.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kaliya haddii ay degdeg tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: What is her name?
dialogue.somali: Magaceedu waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
